crossRefs.note: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to…
Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed…

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
translations.bsb: And the princes of Moab arose, returned to Balak, and said, “Balaam refused to come with us.”
translations.kjv: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come
translations.asv: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
